objective: Reduce BUKLOD public Wall comment vertical spacing and preserve functional comment behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source 90167a90ab7f42de34fa57db6874f9e064826ad3 observed Nov 22 2026; source-only, not live OTA proof.
chosenApproach: Compact shared comment bubble, thread, footer, toolbar and sheet. Hide No Cluster when no cluster exists, and display shorter Manila-local footer timestamps while retaining full date details.
selectionRationale: Screenshots show oversized bubble, repeated absent-cluster label and long timestamp causing excess vertical space. Presentation-only fixes minimize regression risk.
preserveBehaviors: Preserve comment data, ordering, replies, reactions and summaries.
Preserve media, mentions, GIF/photo/emoji compose, edit/delete/report and profile interactions.
Preserve native runtime, navigation callbacks, AdMob placement, authentication and permissions; no release changes.
acceptanceChecks: Run focused Node layout/action regression checks.
Run Jest formatter unit tests and compile/test CI checks.
Run mandatory engineering protected-feature/scope gate without bypass.
No new native, backend, Season 2, or staging/production OTA publishing in this change.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Presentation-only changes to comment bubble, sheet, thread and composer while retaining all runtime and media callbacks.
preservedBehaviors: All existing reactions, menu actions, media, ads, content integrity, sessions and navigation continue unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: The scoped Wall tab comment-sheet styles change but routing, profile taps, and authenticated ownership checks do not.
preservedBehaviors: Wall navigation, comment modal close, author profile links and edit/delete permissions remain intact.

alternativeApproaches: Remove actions and reaction summaries (rejected; loses capability).
Shorten the entire comments sheet (rejected; increases scrolling).
Rewrite the comment data layer (rejected; unnecessary risk).
releaseTarget: future independent release review, not an automatic publication
